about: Apex Conductor rule register (docs/28 §6, docs/31). Every rule is frozen on its date: test days are the trading days AFTER first_test_day - 1, never earlier. A rule is never edited; a change is a new rule with a new id and a new date. Evidence of the freeze date: the git commit that added the rule. Entry conditions are evaluated at the TRIGGER second (the last completed virtual second before the trigger, docs/28 §16a) on data that had ARRIVED by then (recv_ns), never on exchange time.

definitions.expiry_day: the nearest weekly Nifty expiry is today (the engine's dte0 / D.dte0).
definitions.trade_direction: d = +1 for a call (CE), -1 for a put (PE).
definitions.spot_1hz: the engine's trusted in-session 1-Hz Nifty spot (engine_main spot_hist feed: in session, spot age <= SPOT_STALE_S, the D-132 guard applied).
definitions.ER60: trend efficiency of the last 60 minutes: m_k = the last spot_1hz sample at or before t - 60*k seconds, k = 0..60; ER60 = |m_0 - m_60| / sum_{k=1..60} |m_{k-1} - m_k|; DIR60 = sign(m_0 - m_60). Undefined (rule blocks the entry) if any m_k has no sample within 5 s before its mark, if the sum is 0, or before 10:15:00.
definitions.BREADTH_DIR: share of heavyweight index weight moving with the trade: for each of the domino's heavyweight stocks i (universe weight w_i = wn > 0, ltp > 0 now and 300 s ago), c_i = ltp_i(t) / ltp_i(t - 300 s) - 1; BREADTH_DIR = sum of w_i with sign(c_i) = d divided by sum of w_i over stocks with a finite c_i (c_i = 0 counts in the denominator only). Undefined (rule blocks the entry) with fewer than 2 stocks or a zero denominator.
definitions.family: assigned per trade from what the trade carries (docs/28 §16a): ep_type, with council trades split by their signal prefix into COUNCIL-EXP / COUNCIL-NORM, x day type.

rules.name: Spot retest on expiry days: entries end 11:30
rules.condition: on an expiry_day, no entry with a trigger time at or after 11:30:00 (spot_expiry_end = (11, 30)).
rules.source: existing variant (config.py, D-131 / council m28 'R3'), first live day 21 Oct; seeded per B14 with its original date, not re-dated
rules.reason: config.py: m28 'R3': expiry day entries end 11:30

rules.name: Normal days: trend followers only after a trending last hour
rules.family: SPOT-BREAKOUT, SPOT-RETEST, SPOT-RETEST-FILL, SPOT-PULLBACK, ORB, the domino types (CO-FIRST, FORMING, BASKET-LED, FUTURES-LED), FOLLOW, COUNCIL-NORM; each x normal_day
rules.condition: on a normal_day, enter only if ER60 >= 0.35 and DIR60 = d at the trigger second; otherwise (including before 10:15 and whenever ER60 is undefined) no entry.
rules.restricted_book: each family's representative with this condition added (spot_dc12_t12, spot_dc12_t12_first, spot_pb45, spot_orb45, m1.5_s0.4, gap3_s0.4, fade_switch, c20_9x)
rules.source: hand-written (docs/28 §13 stage 4); 0.35 is the regime's own DIRECTIONAL efficiency threshold (regime.py), used unchanged
rules.reason: a trend-following entry on a normal day needs a trend behind it

rules.name: Breakout and impulse families only with breadth >= 60 %
rules.family: SPOT-BREAKOUT, ORB, SPOT-PULLBACK (the 45-min impulse), the domino types (CO-FIRST, FORMING, BASKET-LED, FUTURES-LED); both day types
rules.condition: enter only if BREADTH_DIR >= 0.60 at the trigger second; otherwise (including undefined) no entry.
rules.restricted_book: each family's representative with this condition added (spot_dc12_t12_first, spot_orb45, spot_pb45, m1.5_s0.4, gap3_s0.4)
rules.source: hand-written (docs/28 §13 stage 4); 60 % is the regime's own DIRECTIONAL breadth threshold (regime.py), measured here in the TRADE's direction rather than the futures' 5-min direction
rules.reason: a breakout the big stocks do not join is a futures-only move

rules.name: Council books on normal days: mornings only
rules.condition: on a normal_day, no council entry with a trigger time at or after 12:00:00.
rules.restricted_book: c20_9x with this condition added (representative; reported for every council book)
rules.source: hand-written (docs/28 §13 stage 4)
rules.reason: council normal-day signals are cleanest while the morning trend is forming

rules.name: Long-hold families: no entry in the last 45 minutes
rules.family: families whose MEDIAN hold on the live record 19 Oct - 6 Nov exceeds 15 min, fixed today: ORB only (median 24.9 min, 14 trades). Not included, on the same numbers: SPOT-PULLBACK 14.0 min, COUNCIL-NORM 11.7 min, COUNCIL-EXP 7.6 min, all others under 5 min
rules.condition: no entry with a trigger time at or after 14:30:00 (LAST_ENTRY 15:15 minus 45 min); both day types.
rules.source: hand-written (docs/28 §13 stage 4); membership measured from hold times only (no win / loss used), frozen now
rules.reason: a trade that needs 15+ minutes has no room after 14:30 before the flatten
rules.note: close to empty on the record so far: the ORB book made no entry after 14:30 between 19 Oct and 6 Nov

rules.name: Spot dual: no trend entry in range mode
rules.condition: as coded in the variant: range_gate=True (no entry while the day state is in range mode)
rules.source: existing variant, seeded per B14 (config.py, 22 Oct)

rules.name: Pullback: no impulse measured across a data gap

rules.source: existing variant, seeded per B14 (config.py, 28 Oct evening review)
rules.reason: config.py: '01: no pullback measured across a data gap'

rules.name: BOOK:c20_9y: agree_same >= 7
rules.condition: enter only if weather_trig.agree_same >= 7 at the trigger second (docs/27, apex/engine/weather.py); a missing value blocks the entry
rules.restricted_book: c20_9y family vote (SHADOW: not in the pool, logged only)
rules.source: 10-agent rule team, 8-9 Nov (found by searching the past; pre-registered, shadow; frozen before the 9 Nov open)
rules.reason: rule team 9 Nov (data/replay/batch/v3_cards_2026-11-08/team/TEAM_REPORT.md): 12 of 12 trades with one earlier council sibling silent lost on the 14 replayed days (1 on the held-out days); full-width shuffle test does not beat luck, so it is frozen here as a pre-registered hypothesis and judged on live days only
